mechanics.claim: Marks the target enemy champion or medium/large monster with a curse for 5 seconds; the next basic attack or ability hit against the target consumes the mark.
mechanics.quote: marks the target enemy {{tip|champion}} or medium or large {{tip|monster}} with a curse for 5 seconds

mechanics.claim: Consuming the mark slows the target by 45% for 0.75 seconds and refunds Allure's mana cost.
mechanics.quote: slowing them by 45% for {{fd|0.75}} seconds and refunding ''Allure's'' {{as|{{sti|mana|mana cost}}}}

mechanics.claim: If the mark was applied for at least 2.5 seconds before being consumed, the consumption is empowered, applying magic resist reduction to champions (for 4 seconds) or bonus damage and extra charm duration to monsters.
mechanics.quote: If the target was marked for at least {{fd|2.5}} seconds, the consumption is empowered.

mechanics.claim: The magic resistance reduction debuff is applied to the attack or ability that triggers the empowered consumption.
mechanics.quote: The {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance reduction}}}} will be applied to the attack or ability that triggers it.

mechanics.claim: Against monsters, the empowered trigger deals bonus magic damage and increases charm duration by 2.25 seconds.
mechanics.quote: the triggering effect deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and the duration of the {{tip|charm}} is increased by {{fd|2.25}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Allure's mark application cannot be blocked by spell shield, but the mark's consumption will not occur if the triggering ability is blocked by a spell shield, leaving the mark on the target.
mechanics.quote:
''Allure's'' mark application on a target cannot be blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}.
** The mark's consumption will not occur if the ability is blocked by a spell shield, causing the mark to remain on the target.

mechanics.claim: If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or out of sight during the cast time, the ability cancels but still goes on cooldown and pays its cost.
mechanics.quote: If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away or no longer in {{tip|sight}} during the cast time, this ability will cancel but still go on {{sti|cooldown}} and pay its cost.

mechanics.claim: Allure will restart its cooldown whenever the mark debuff is removed.
mechanics.quote: ''Allure'' will restart its cooldown whenever the mark debuff is removed.

mechanics.claim: Casting Allure does not break Demon Shade nor its fade into it.
mechanics.quote: ''Casting Allure does not break {{ai|Demon Shade|Evelynn}} nor its fade into it.''
